display_long_description:
Downtown Club is a highly polished urban motorsport game built from the ground up for VR, featuring state-of-the-art motion controls and exciting driving feedback. Grab the steering wheel and get ready to race against fierce opponents!
[media]
# 🏁 Play it your way
Win Events with customizable difficulty and use Tickets to unlock more content, or play various game modes both offline and online, with voice chat and private or public rooms! Create custom races, explore the map freely, or challenge worldwide lap times via driver ghosts.
[media]
# 🚗 Packed with features
Drive under different weather conditions in a large city featuring freeways, tunnels and parking lots. Race on different racetrack layouts, create custom opponents, mix and match driver suit parts, and adjust a wide range of options to adapt the game to your preference. Compatible with bHaptics!
[media]
# 📢 Actively developed
Downtown Club currently features one large city map and three different cars, each in Standard and Sport versions. Free updates are coming soon with more cars and maps inspired by international car culture: our small team is always working under the hood and listening to your feedback!
[media]
